newsitem.title: USA: Nintendo offers Nintendo 64 in U.S.
newsitem.headline: Nintendo offers Nintendo 64 in U.S.

text.p: Nintendo of America Inc said Monday it is introducing Nintendo 64 to the U.S. market for $199.95.
The subsidiary of Japan's Nintendo Co Ltd said it believes it will sell its entire supply, more than one million units, in North America over the next six months.
The product was developed and licensed jointly with Silicon Graphics Inc and will include Super Mario 64 and PilotWings 64, a 3-D flight simulation adventure, each for $69.95, Nintendo said.

The company said there are already large pre-sell orders for Nintendo 64 and it will push to sell one million systems and three million games in the final six months of its fiscal year ending March 1997.
